title: Bushen Jianpi Tiaoxue Decoction (BJTD) ameliorates oxidative stress and apoptosis induced by uterus ageing through activation of the SIRT1/NRF2 pathway.
authors: Zhang, Jiacheng; Hu, Hangqi; Zhu, Yutian; Jin, Yuxin; Zhang, Haolin; Fan, Ruiwen; Ye, Yang; Xin, Xiyan; Li, Dong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方BJTD通过SIRT1/NRF2通路改善子宫衰老的氧化应激与凋亡，属纯湿实验与网络药理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Uterus ageing is a crucial factor contributing to decreased fertility in older women and is also implicated in menstrual disorders, endometritis, and adenomyosis. Bushen Jianpi Tiaoxue Decoction (BJTD) is a traditional Chinese medicine formulation used to ameliorate endocrine disorders in the female reproductive system and finds extensive application in ageing-related endometrial diseases. However, the mechanisms underlying its improvement of uterus ageing have not been thoroughly investigated. PURPOSE: To explore the potential components and mechanisms of BJTD in ameliorating uterus ageing through network pharmacology, in vivo, and in vitro experiments. METHODS: Morphological changes were observed using hematoxylin and eosin staining, collagen deposition was assessed using Masson staining, and apoptotic-related molecules were detected using Western blot. After determining the modeling doses, BJTD intervention was administered at two doses, and the expression of oxidative stress and apoptosis-related genes and proteins was measured. The levels of cellular apoptosis were evaluated using the TUNEL assay kit and Annexin V/FITC-PI assay kit. The main components of BJTD were determined by UPLC-MS, and the potential targets and mechanisms of BJTD action were explored using network pharmacology and molecular docking. BJTD-Containing Serum (BJTD-S) was extracted and applied in vitro experiments using human endometrial stroma cells (hESC) to preliminarily identify the pathways affected. RESULTS: We demonstrated that modeling with 600 mg/kg/day D-Gal for 5 weeks significantly increased collagen deposition in uterine tissues, particularly in the glands and stroma. Additionally, it significantly elevated the levels of TNF-alpha and IL-1beta and increased the expression of p53 and BAX while decreasing BCL-2 expression. BJTD significantly reduced the increased levels of TNF-alpha and IL-1beta induced by D-Gal, and modulated oxidative stress markers such as SOD, MDA, GSH-Px, and T-AOC. BJTD also inhibited the cascade activation of apoptosis induced by D-Gal, suppressing the expression of cleaved-Caspase 8, cleaved-Caspase 3, and BAX. SIRT1 is a potential target of BJTD action. In vitro experiments showed that BJTD-S significantly improved D-Gal-induced apoptosis in hESC cells, and the expression levels of SIRT1, NRF2, and HO-1 were significantly decreased in D-Gal-induced hESC, and BJTD-S significantly increased their expression. CONCLUSION: BJTD can ameliorate oxidative stress and cell apoptosis levels in D-Gal-induced uterine aging, and its active ingredients can activate the SIRT1/NRF2 pathway to exert its effects. Importantly, our study provides novel insights into the molecular mechanisms by which traditional Chinese medicine influence uterus ageing. By specifically targeting the SIRT1/NRF2 pathway, BJTD presents a unique therapeutic approach that has not been extensively explored in previous studies, marking a significant advancement in the treatment of uterus ageing.
abstract_zh: 背景：子宫衰老是导致高龄女性生育能力下降的关键因素，同时也与月经紊乱、子宫内膜炎和子宫腺肌病相关。补肾健脾调血汤（BJTD）是一种用于改善女性生殖系统内分泌紊乱的中药方剂，在衰老相关子宫内膜疾病中应用广泛。然而，其改善子宫衰老的机制尚未被深入研究。目的：通过网络药理学、体内和体外实验，探讨BJTD改善子宫衰老的潜在成分和机制。方法：采用苏木精-伊红染色观察形态学变化，Masson染色评估胶原沉积，Western blot检测凋亡相关分子。确定建模剂量后，以两种剂量给予BJTD干预，并测量氧化应激和凋亡相关基因及蛋白的表达。使用TUNEL检测试剂盒和Annexin V/FITC-PI检测试剂盒评估细胞凋亡水平。通过UPLC-MS确定BJTD的主要成分，并利用网络药理学和分子对接探索BJTD作用的潜在靶点和机制。提取含BJTD血清（BJTD-S），并将其应用于人子宫内膜基质细胞（hESC）的体外实验，以初步识别受影响的通路。结果：我们证明，以600 mg/kg/天的D-半乳糖建模5周，显著增加了子宫组织中的胶原沉积，尤其是在腺体和基质中。此外，它显著提高了TNF-α和IL-1β的水平，并增加了p53和BAX的表达，同时降低了BCL-2的表达。BJTD显著降低了D-半乳糖诱导的TNF-α和IL-1β升高水平，并调节了SOD、MDA、GSH-Px和T-AOC等氧化应激标志物。BJTD还抑制了D-半乳糖诱导的凋亡级联激活，抑制了cleaved-Caspase 8、cleaved-Caspase 3和BAX的表达。SIRT1是BJTD作用的潜在靶点。体外实验显示，BJTD-S显著改善了D-半乳糖诱导的hESC细胞凋亡，且在D-半乳糖诱导的hESC中，SIRT1、NRF2和HO-1的表达水平显著降低，而BJTD-S显著增加了它们的表达。结论：BJTD能够改善D-半乳糖诱导的子宫衰老中的氧化应激和细胞凋亡水平，其活性成分可激活SIRT1/NRF2通路以发挥效应。重要的是，我们的研究为中药影响子宫衰老的分子机制提供了新的见解。通过特异性靶向SIRT1/NRF2通路，BJTD呈现了一种在以往研究中未被广泛探索的独特治疗策略，标志着子宫衰老治疗领域的重大进展。
